title: Full versus cut Coulomb in the exact-exchange operator

use_fullcoul_exx.meaning: LibRPA switch selecting the full Coulomb interaction in the exact-exchange operator; false selects the truncated Coulomb matrix.

adjust.symptom: a cut-Coulomb EXX definition is deliberately required
adjust.effect: set use_fullcoul_exx = f only for that explicit definition
adjust.guard: a cut-Coulomb result needs its own definition-matched benchmark; do not compare it to full-Coulomb references as if they were the same definition

constraints: oml default is t (user decision 2026-10-23); the LibRPA documented default is false.
With use_abacus_gw_symmetry=t the flag is ineffective: LibRPA takes the IBZ full-Coulomb branch regardless of the flag.
